answer: Ephemeral Attestation Windows. Each identity earns standing only by answering live challenges whose seed derives from recent chain state, so replies can't be precomputed or copied; a cloned agent hits a ledge when its frozen answers miss the current window. Attacker cost is continuous runtime presence per identity, not a one-time fee. Honest agents vine their history across windows, and a real operator can harbor many identities only by staffing each window separately.
